meta.title: HAI VAN PASS: IS IT WORTH THE HYPE? 🇻🇳 Vietnam Motorbike Special - Top Gear | VIETNAM VLOG
meta.description:
Today we do the famous Hai Van Pass in Vietnam! Is it worth the hype?

let's figure it out together ;)

➡ Vietnam Motorbike Special Part 1 - Top Gear - Series 12 - BBC https://youtu.be/O1zfuBgCUqY

Let me know in the comments below if you have ever done the Hai Van Pass (share your experience and opinion) or maybe you are planning to do it?

Thanks for watching and I wish you a beautiful day! :)

Gabi

comments.text: I've done the hai van pass a couple of times simply because I'm an avid top gear fan and it definitely didn't disappoint, no video can really do it justice

comments.author: @Borg14
comments.text: There are so many amazing coastal roads in Vietnam.  Hai Van is popular because most tourist are only in Da Nang for a few days.  So it is a quick & easy ride to do.  Wait until you do the North side, amazing rides there.

comments.author: @patnewman1
comments.text: While I visited Vietnam in January 2020 I stayed in DaNang as a base but actually visited Hue and Phu Bai which were places that I served while in the US Army  101st Airborne Division. Because I visited those areas looking for certain things from my time while serving, I drove the Hai Van Pass 4 times round trip. It is one of the most fun rides that I have had because of the elevation and also the views of the coast are unbelievable. Seeing those pristine beaches were awe inspiring. Nice job again Gabi.

comments.text: It’s funny now that it’s a tourist attraction. When I lived in vietnam as a child, I kept hearing people talked about how dangerous it was because of the narrow roads.
